newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-BECKER PULLS OUT OF STOCKHOLM OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER PULLS OUT OF STOCKHOLM OPEN.

text.p: Boris Becker pulled out of next week's $825,000 Stockholm Open tournament on Friday, blaming an ankle tendon injury and the hectic ATP shedule.

A short statement released by Becker's manager said it was difficult to understand why this week's Paris Open had to begin straight after the Stuttgart Open, which Becker won last week with a thrilling victory in the final over Peter Sampras.
The German star crashed out in the first round of the Paris tournament, losing to Carlos Moya of Spain.
